goal: GX-002 scope-stack receiver type inference: build a local-variable type-inference pass on top of call-resolver.ts so method calls on locals and prototypes (x.toFixed(), element.slice()) resolve deterministically - a scope-chain binding table tracking const x = new Foo() so x.method() resolves to Foo.method(). Targets the receiver_not_in_symbol_table class: ~62% (10,691) of coderef-core's ~17,280 unresolved edges; current resolution rate 22.32%. Program: core-improvements-731 PLAN.md Option A (GX-002 first, ruled). Honors the 2026-07-09 js_prototype_member builtin-reclassify ruling; both adjacency indexes + incremental parity apply

tasks.description: Read the receiver-resolution path end-to-end and confirm exactly where locals fail: call-resolver.ts resolution ladder, the symbol-table construction it queries, field-index.ts, and the graph-builder call-edge emission incl. the 2026-07-09 js_prototype_member builtin-reclassify site (ordering must be preserved). Record the failure taxonomy of receiver_not_in_symbol_table edges (local const/let bindings, params, this, destructuring).

Capture the BEFORE baseline explicitly (KZ-01KYTSCY): validation_status resolution_rate (22.32%), total unresolved (18069), and the receiver_not_in_symbol_table count (~10691) broken down by reason; persist the numbers in analysis.json so the after-diff is a real diff, not a recollection.

Record the design in analysis.json: a scope-chain binding table (scope-stack) tracking local variable types from `const x = new Foo()`, typed params, and annotated declarations, consulted by the resolution ladder BEFORE the builtin/js_prototype_member reclassify. State what is deliberately OUT of scope (cross-file dataflow, generics narrowing, union receivers).

Implement the scope-stack binding pass as a new module (e.g. src/pipeline/scope-binding.ts): per-file scope tree with variable->type bindings from new-expressions, annotations, and typed params; pure and deterministic; exported API consumed by call-resolver.

Wire the binding table into call-resolver.ts: on receiver lookup miss, consult the scope-stack binding before falling through to js_prototype_member/builtin reclassify, resolving x.method() to Foo.method() when the binding is unambiguous; emit resolved-call evidence with scopePath.

Incremental parity: a full scan and a --incremental rescan of the same tree must produce identical resolution results (edge counts and statuses); also confirm no new edge KIND was introduced (so the two adjacency indexes need no change) - if one was, both canonical-graph.ts and cli/mcp/graph-tools.ts must learn it in this same phase.

Author unit tests for the binding pass (new-expr binding, param typing, shadowing, reassignment, miss->fallthrough) and run tests_for_change plus the full suite; suite must be green (confirm actual counts - vitest startup crash reads as fail, verify numbers).

Capture the AFTER metrics on a fresh self-scan and diff against the P1-T2 baseline: resolution_rate delta, receiver_not_in_symbol_table count delta, zero regressions in previously-resolved edges (scip_resolution_delta as the independent cross-check); persist the diff in analysis.json.
Commit Phase 1 with the metrics delta in the commit body.
Hard stop: report the before/after resolution numbers to the operator for final approval before close.
